correctness.rationale: The normalized chord law yields exact raw first/second moments and the centroid subtraction, including the key h^2(M3-M2^2/A) term. For every triangle its fiber length is a tent of projection width w; the moment integrals M2=4A^2/(3w), M3=2A^3/w^2 hold by direct integration. The polar difference body of a reference triangle is an area-three hexagon; affine covariance proves E(1/w^2)=3/(2pi A). Rotational averaging gives E I(S)=I/2+A^2/(4pi)+h^2A^2/(3pi). Exact Heron and centroidal triangle inertia establish the sharp threshold and equality cases. The submitted stand-alone verifier passed 35 exact/algebraic or independent quadrature comparisons (115200 directions), with explicitly finite scope.
